cases.prompt:
FlavourBench executable culinary decision task. Epicure is the deterministic scoring environment. Select the best portfolio using culinary knowledge; do not browse or call external tools. Partial credit reflects the quality of the complete selection.

Family: substitution
Select three alternatives to `boursin cheese` that best preserve its dairy role, regional context, and mutual portfolio coherence.

Candidates:
A. caciocavallo
B. fromage blanc
C. quail egg
D. egg white
E. whipped topping
F. goose egg
G. goat milk
H. grana padano

Choose exactly 3 distinct labels. Return exactly one line beginning with the marker `FINAL_SELECTION:`, followed by the three selected A-through-H labels separated by commas and ordered alphabetically.
cases.selection_rule: largest observed score gap within family; illustrative only
